title: Anthropic S-1: of its $80.7B net loss in H1 2026, nearly $9B came from computing power and infrastructure, and it has nearly $800B in commitments over 10 years (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Anthropic S-1: of its $80.7B net loss in H1 2026, nearly $9B came from computing power and infrastructure, and it has nearly $800B in commitments over 10 years — 240,000-word prospectus lays out explosive growth alongside steep losses and daunting risk factors
